Update the pinned Chasen and Chasen Graphics dependencies.

Requires Zig **0.16.0**.

## Changed

- Update Chasen to [v0.1.2](https://github.com/hiroaqii/chasen/releases/tag/v0.1.2),
  including its input lifecycle fixes.
- Update Chasen Graphics to
  [v0.1.1](https://github.com/hiroaqii/chasen-graphics/releases/tag/v0.1.1).
- Run the existing tests and all 40 example builds on macOS as well as Linux.
- Update the development guide's dependency and CI information.

## Compatibility

UI APIs and component implementations are unchanged. The Chasen Anim dependency
remains at v0.1.0.

Custom POSIX `std.Io` users should check Chasen's
[terminal capacity requirements](https://github.com/hiroaqii/chasen/blob/v0.1.2/docs/RUNTIME.md#runtime-configuration).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/hiroaqii/chasen-ui/compare/v0.1.1...v0.1.2
